description: Benchmark baseline captured after Tranche V (recognizer-family transposition). The transposition lands the substrate (V.1-V.10): csp-solver Implication+Cardinality constraints, RegexClass extensions (CharClassQuantified/PrefixThenClass/AccelDriven), EngineSet bitset on RegexInfo, RecognizerInfo trait extensions with Token/DispatchGroup/DelimScan wrappers, NodeFacts.recognizer field with Recognizer/RecognizerShape/RecognizerSignature, mine_recognizers pass with eight miners, csp_recognizers pass producing per-NodeId RecognizerDecisionMap, backend/kernels/ family directory, DriverState::recognizer_decision accessor, and a consumer-invariant grep test. The legacy backend/patterns/{delim_scan,key_dispatch,cache}.rs detection halves stay operational pending the strategy-solver migration in follow-up tranche W.
arch: four-layer optimizer: e-graph (equivalence) / facts (legality) / CSP (choice) / backend (emission). Tranche V completes the facts/CSP/backend connective tissue: structural mining produces RecognizerShape, V.6 CSP derives per-NodeId decisions, V.7 kernel directory hosts family-specific helpers, V.8 driver accessor reads decisions. The strategy-solver migration that fully consumes ir.recognizer_decisions ships in tranche W.

notes.parse_time_delta: Parse-time rows show a uniform ~2-4% slowdown vs post-T. The generated parser code is functionally identical (recognize_patterns body migrated verbatim into mine_recognizers/node_facts.rs); the delta is consistent with rebuild noise + cache layout sensitivity that cold-iter benchmarks pick up. No source-level regression in generated emission paths is hypothesized — the V.6 decisions are populated but unconsumed by drivers.
notes.compile_time_delta: Compile-pipeline rows show a real +6-10% regression on small grammars (compile_bbnf, compile_ebnf, compile_json) and +1-3% on larger ones (css_l4, css_mono, sheets). The cost is the new V.4 mining pass (eight miners producing Recognizer records) + V.6 CSP solving + the upstream compute_context_facts call (previously not in the production pipeline). The work is currently 'spent without gain' because no emission consumer reads ir.recognizer_decisions; the follow-up tranche W migrates strategy solvers and recoups the cost via dropped legacy detection in backend/patterns/.
notes.follow_up_blockers: The aggressive deletions originally scoped for V.9 (scanner_plan.rs, generalized/, backend/patterns/{delim_scan,key_dispatch,cache}.rs, passes/transform/fuse_token/) are blocked on the strategy-solver migration. Tranche W deletes them once decide_alt_strategy / decide_seq_strategy / decide_wrap_strategy migrate to read ir.recognizer_decisions exclusively.
